verdict.rationale: The evidence documents only Superset's own MCP server, which lets other agents and scripts drive Superset. That is the server role, and it does not transfer to this story. Nothing in the pack shows Superset letting users register or connect external MCP servers so Superset or its hosted agents can call their tools.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can plug MCP servers into this product so it can use their tools
